default.name: baseline_accept

default.description: Explicit user/Appraise interrupt relay: cancel active baseline executions and return the plan to baseline changes requested.

default.name: baseline_failure_acknowledge

default.name: baseline_start
default.description: Agent-owned execution tool: start required baseline executions after validation review approval.

default.description: Approve implementation groups and receive currently runnable task IDs.

default.name: implementation_start

default.description: Create a durable bounded handoff with Appraise-authored state and an agent-authored semantic narrative.

default.name: plan_create
default.description: Create a structured AppraiseJS plan with a short title in goal and a separate description, then wait until its review surface is ready.

goal.description: Short plan title, limited to 80 characters. Put supporting detail in description.

description.description: Concise summary of the plan scope, intent, and expected outcome.

default.name: plan_event_acknowledge
default.description: Idempotently acknowledge one delivered plan event.

default.description: Idempotently acknowledge every delivered plan event through a sequence in one bounded update.

default.name: plan_events_read
default.description: Read unacknowledged plan events without acknowledging them.

default.name: plan_lifecycle_health
default.description: Read bounded lifecycle invariant health, orphaned managed runs, and authorized recovery actions for a plan.

default.name: plan_lifecycle_snapshot
default.description: Create a content-addressed Appraise-owned lifecycle snapshot for bounded continuation.

default.name: plan_read
default.description: Read the current plan artifact and content hash.

default.name: plan_review_loop
default.description: Preferred Appraise review standby loop: wait for review readiness when needed, then wait with bounded long-poll semantics for approved, changes_requested, or cancelled.

default.name: plan_review_read
default.description: Read plan-review remarks, review hash, blocking/non-blocking threads, orphaned thread IDs, links, and recovery guidance without acknowledging events.

default.name: plan_revise
default.description: Submit a higher plan revision with a short title in goal and a separate description using an exact expected content hash.

goal.description: Short plan title, limited to 80 characters. Put supporting detail in description.

description.description: Concise summary of the plan scope, intent, and expected outcome.

default.name: plan_start
default.description: Start validation preparation for an approved plan revision.

default.name: plan_task_update
default.description: Publish a durable task progress update.

default.name: plan_wait_for_approval
default.description: Read-only wait for the plan approval gate; defaults to bounded polling and preserves explicit long-poll mode for clients that can safely wait.

default.name: plan_wait_for_review
default.description: Wait for the durable plan_review_ready event before presenting the review URL.

default.name: planning_session_create
default.description: Normal-agent entry point: diagnose, optionally register a target workspace, persist an agent-authored plan, wait for review readiness, then return standby instructions. AppraiseJS validates and gates the supplied plan but does not infer tasks from a brief.

goal.description: Short plan title, limited to 80 characters. Put supporting detail in description.

description.description: Concise summary of the plan scope, intent, and expected outcome.

default.name: project_add
default.description: Attach an existing application repository as a target project and write a non-blocking .appraisejs/project.json continuity marker when writable.

default.name: project_diagnostic
default.description: Verify application/API reachability, authentication, project identity, Git reproducibility, and contract compatibility.

default.name: project_list
default.description: List application repositories attached to the local AppraiseJS hub.

default.name: step_block_search
default.description: Search reusable step blocks before proposing custom validation step sequences.

default.name: template_step_match
default.description: Rank reusable template steps and step blocks for a behavior intent before proposing custom steps.

default.name: template_step_search
default.description: Resolve live template steps with ranked intent and parameter compatibility before proposing custom steps.

default.name: test_run
default.description: Run existing Appraise-compatible Cucumber/Playwright artifacts from an attached target repository and record a managed Appraise test run.

default.name: test_run_diagnose
default.description: Diagnose invalid or suspicious managed test-run evidence with concise blockers and next action.

default.name: test_run_preflight
default.description: Read-only blocker check before creating a managed target test run. Use this before plan-bound test_run calls.

default.name: test_run_read
default.description: Read bounded status and evidence summary for a managed Appraise test run.

default.name: validation_ast_check
default.description: check a bounded Validation AST against authoritative plan, catalog, locator, and environment context.

default.name: validation_ast_compile
default.description: Project an exactly previewed Validation AST into canonical entities without runtime materialization.

default.name: validation_ast_extension_policy
default.description: Read the bounded, versioned custom-extension capability policy for an authoritative target plan.

default.name: validation_ast_extension_reviews
default.description: Read exact bounded extension reviews and the hash required to bind a review decision.

default.name: validation_ast_preview
default.description: preview a bounded Validation AST against authoritative plan, catalog, locator, and environment context.

default.name: validation_context_read
default.description: Read live Appraise validation-preparation context: current plan tasks, target project metadata, reusable modules, suites, cases, template steps, locators, and environments.

default.name: validation_feedback_submit
default.description: Route validation review feedback as test-artifact changes or product-scope changes with lifecycle invalidation.

default.name: validation_file_approve
default.description: Explicit user/Appraise decision relay: approve one flagged changed file for its exact current content hash.

default.name: validation_resources_abandon
default.description: Idempotently abandon a validation resource proposal before safe cleanup.

default.name: validation_resources_cleanup
default.description: Safely clean abandoned proposal-owned resources; reused or referenced resources are retained and reported.

default.name: validation_resources_propose
default.description: Transactionally propose target-bound managed-validation resources and receive stable IDs plus a refreshed context hash.

default.name: validation_review_loop
default.description: Wait for validation review to resolve through validations_approved, validation_changes_requested, or cancellation.

default.name: validation_review_reconcile
default.description: Reconcile a review_ready validation after a crash by preserving immutable publication content and refreshing only the exact current review-state receipt.

default.name: validation_review_submit
default.description: Explicit user/Appraise decision relay: submit the revision-level validation review after all required decisions are current.
